preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 20, inclusive.
The length of each string A and B is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
Strings A and B have the same length N.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A + B)
preconditions.description: Each character in A and B is a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if any(A[i] > B[i] for i in range(N)) else output
postconditions.description: Output is -1 if there is any index i such that A[i] > B[i], meaning it's impossible to convert A to B.

postconditions.expression: output[0] == K if output != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, the first element of the output is the minimum number of operations K.

postconditions.expression: output[1:K+1] == [S for S in operations if len(S) > 0] if output != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, the following K elements are the operations, where each operation is a list of indices to be replaced.

invariants.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A + B)
invariants.description: The characters in A and B are lowercase English letters.
